card.text: 2002 TC302 has a flattened outline measured during a stellar occultation. Its displayed depth is assumed; newer thermal analysis suggests a possible companion, which is not part of this primary-body model.

model.title: Occultation-outline illustration
model.summary: The 2018 occultation gives projected full axes 543.2 ±18 × 459.5 ±11 km. This smooth axisymmetric illustration assumes an unseen equatorial depth of 543.2 km and equator-on presentation; true 3D flattening is unresolved. It represents the primary outline, not the larger thermal system-size estimate. Illustrative ICRF pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and rotational phase. A projected limb position angle is not an inertial pole measurement. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
